en.title: Web app testing
en.description: Inspect a local website and write Playwright checks for real user flows.
tasks: Inspect a local website and write Playwright checks for real user flows.
prerequisites: An AI agent that can read local Skill files. Provide your task context and source materials.
Python, Playwright with Chromium, and a local app you are authorized to test.
en.example: Use webapp-testing for this task: Inspect a local website and write Playwright checks for real user flows. First ask me for the missing context. Use only the evidence I provide or sources you can verify, and explain what I should check in the result.
en.expectedResult: A task-specific draft or analysis, with assumptions, evidence gaps, and clear next steps for you to review.
limitations: Review factual claims and proposed actions before relying on the output.
Source and package checks are complete; no end-to-end Agent task verification is claimed.

zh.title: 网页应用测试
zh.description: 检查本地网站，用 Playwright 验证真实用户操作流程。
tasks: 检查本地网站，用 Playwright 验证真实用户操作流程。
prerequisites: 可读取本地 Skill 文件的 AI Agent；准备任务背景与原始材料。
Python、已安装 Chromium 的 Playwright，以及有权限测试的本地应用。
zh.example: 请使用 webapp-testing 完成以下任务：检查本地网站，用 Playwright 验证真实用户操作流程。 先询问缺少的背景信息，只使用我提供的证据或可以核验的来源，并说明结果需要检查哪些内容。
zh.expectedResult: 得到针对任务的草稿或分析，包含假设、证据缺口和可供检查的后续步骤。
limitations: 使用输出前核对事实依据和建议操作。
已完成来源与包文件检查，尚未声明完成 Agent 端到端任务验证。
